blogs.title: Warp Specialisation – Turning GPU Latency Into Lightning Attention
blogs.description: Engineers always fight hidden stalls when feeding matrix multiplications on modern GPUs. In FlashAttention‑3 we split thread blocks into producer warps that load data via TMA and consumer warps that crunch it via Tensor Cores. By overlapping these two pipelines users see near‑full utilisation and dramatic speedups with barely any algorithmic change.

blogs.title: Softmax Meets Matrix Multiplication There Goes Your Bottleneck
blogs.description: Softmax looks tiny compared with large GEMMs—yet it runs on much slower hardware units and can waste precious cycles looking upstream waiting for matrix products. FlashAttention‑3 breaks those dependencies by pipelining an entire softmax round onto the next GEMM’s lane—think One worker washing plates while another cooks pizza nearby—doubling effective throughput almost automatically.

blogs.title: FP8 Transformers Made Practical – Block Quantisation + Random Orthogonalisation Yields Petaflop Speed & Accuracy
blogs.description: Low precision brings higher FLOPS per watt but shoots error spikes when outliers lurk inside attention tensors. FlashAttention‑3 keeps every block tightly scaled (block quantisation) and spreads extreme values out before rounding via a cheap orthogonal remix (incoherent processing). The result? Double FLOPS versus FP16 plus roughly three times lower numerical error versus naïve per-tensor approaches.

blogs.title: FlashAttention – The New Standard for Fast Long-Context Models
blogs.description: With Hopper GPUs Folding over one petaflop per second on FP8 passes and sustaining ~740 TFLOPs/s on FP16 rounds up speed gains well beyond previous kernels—sometimes beating proprietary cuDNN libraries entirely. Open-sourced today and already plug-and-play in PyTorch/Hugging Face pipelines, this means longer documents, larger state machines and richer media can now sit comfortably under your training loop.
